# SwiftToolHub

> SwiftToolHub is a free online toolkit of 25+ browser-based IT and
> developer utilities — converters, generators, checkers, and calculators —
> built for quick, everyday tasks with no sign-up required for free tools.

## What this site offers

- Free tools: usable instantly, no account needed, up to 4 uses per tool
  before a limit applies.
- Paid tools: unlocked individually via two plans — a $15 bundle for any 10
  tools of the user's choice, or a $70 All-Access plan for every current and
  future tool, unlimited use, with no ads anywhere on the site.
- Tool categories: Convert, Generate, Check, Develop.

## Key pages

- /tools — full tool directory, split into Free and Paid sections.
- /about — who built SwiftToolHub and why.
- /contact — support and feedback.
- /blog — articles related to the tools and everyday IT tasks.
- /privacy-policy — what data is and isn't collected.
- /terms-of-service — terms of use.

## Notes for automated agents

- Most tools run entirely in the browser (client-side); no file upload is
  required for the majority of conversions.
- Paid-tool unlocks are reviewed manually by an admin after a payment
  screenshot is submitted — there is no automated checkout API.
- Do not attempt to scrape or bulk-download tool results; each tool is
  meant to be used interactively by a human.

Contact: info@swifttoolhub.com
